cohort: The study included 200 parturient who delivered in the Niger Delta University Teaching hospital in 2019.
finding: Parity, booking status, and mode of delivery were significantly associated with the likelihood of receiving a blood transfusion among parturient.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by caesarean section had a higher tendency to be transfused compared to those with spontaneous vaginal delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical records of deliveries that occurred in 2019.
